dedupe_keys.name: flexgeo deliverable 3 1 dynamic model of a 5th generation district heating and cooling network includes vielha use case

description: Jordi García-Céspedes and co-authors publish a Modelica library of components for dynamic simulation of fifth-generation district heating and cooling networks. The description identifies an extension of Modelica Buildings version 12.1.0 tested and validated in OpenModelica through OMEdit version 1.26.1. The title identifies the Vielha use case. Zenodo lists a GeoDENs ZIP archive and provides it freely under CC BY 4.0. The model therefore supports district-energy network dynamics, with the general component coverage and case application kept distinct. The related Vielha case-study record describes geothermal-network planning. A limitation is that the metadata does not enumerate every component, input, output or validation metric. The stated validation is an author claim; it was not reproduced. Only metadata and the archive descriptor were read, so execution requirements and internal dependencies remain untested.
